# Mohammed Brückner — mohammed-brueckner.com

> Enterprise architect and author based in Munich. Hands-on guides on PlantUML and ArchiMate, platform economics, MLOps with Databricks, change management, and practical enterprise AI adoption.

## Core content

- [PlantUML with ArchiMate: Complete Guide](https://mohammed-brueckner.com/plantuml-how-to/): the site's most-read resource — setup, export, styling, ArchiMate examples, troubleshooting
- [PlantUML ArchiMate Templates](https://mohammed-brueckner.com/plantuml-how-to/templates/): copy-paste starting points for application, technology, business, and migration views
- [PlantUML Troubleshooting](https://mohammed-brueckner.com/plantuml-how-to/troubleshooting/): the error catalog with fixes
- [PlantUML vs. Mermaid](https://mohammed-brueckner.com/plantuml-how-to/plantuml-vs-mermaid/): honest comparison for architecture work
- [Architecture as Code](https://mohammed-brueckner.com/archimate/): why diagrams deserve better than desktop drawing tools
- [Building jArchi for Archi from Source](https://mohammed-brueckner.com/jArchi-Build/): verified build procedure
- [From Discovery to Deployment with AI](https://mohammed-brueckner.com/how-to-ai/): enterprise AI adoption reality check
- [Change Management / Double Trinity Pyramid](https://mohammed-brueckner.com/changemanagement/): why 70% of projects fail
- [Databricks Architecture Overview](https://mohammed-brueckner.com/databricks/) and [Azure Cost Calculator](https://mohammed-brueckner.com/databricks/cost-calculator/)

## Book

- [Platform Economies](https://mohammed-brueckner.com/platform-economies/): How AI Is Rewriting the Rules of Platforms, APIs, and Partnerships. September 2026, ISBN 979-8-1954-5157-8. Available on Amazon (US/UK/DE/JP/CA), ASIN B0GXN4PRB5. Companion site: https://platformeconomies.com
